breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet and periodic. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, like the ground truth, removed the periodic condition, only keeping the Dirichlet conditions: u(0,t)=0 and u(1,t)=0.
